query_objective: Find official USDA/RMA support that distinguishes FCIC data-access/outside-agency-control root causes from recoverable or collectible overpayments.
query_text: site:rma.usda.gov Federal Crop Insurance data access information needed recoverable overpayments CARS compliance activities accounting system
source_scope: official USDA, RMA, FCIC, and PaymentAccuracy sources
capture_rule: Capture canonical URL, observed date, root-cause language, recovery process language, and whether the source separates data-access failures from recoverable or collectible amounts.
success_rule: Success requires official source language that supports the revised root-cause definition and explains whether those amounts are recoverable, collectible, or only reported overpayment estimates.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
query_objective: Find official VA support separating PLTSS documentation, timeliness, and Basic Ordering Agreement errors from recoverable or collectible overpayments.
query_text: site:department.va.gov PLTSS Basic Ordering Agreement recoverable overpayment documentation timeliness post-payment review
source_scope: official VA, VHA, and PaymentAccuracy sources
capture_rule: Capture canonical URL, observed date, PLTSS error categories, overpayment basis, collection or recovery language, and any technical-improper or unknown-payment limitations.
success_rule: Success requires official source language that maps PLTSS error categories to recoverable/collectible overpayments or explicitly blocks that mapping.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

query_objective: Find official CMS support for whether Medicaid PERM improper-payment dollars can be translated into fraud, waste, recoverable amounts, collectible amounts, or savings.
query_text: site:cms.gov Medicaid PERM improper payment recoverable collectible fraud waste abuse savings corrective action plan technical improper
source_scope: official CMS, HHS, OMB, and PaymentAccuracy sources
capture_rule: Capture canonical URL, observed date, PERM improper-payment boundary language, recoverability language, savings language, and technical-improper limitations.
success_rule: Success requires official source language that either authorizes or blocks translating PERM improper-payment estimates into recoverable/savings/waste categories.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

query_objective: Find official CMS support separating the full Part D reported overpayment estimate from recoverable, collectible, or audit-recovered amounts.
query_text: site:cms.gov Part D IPM recoverable collectible overpayment FY2024 PDE audit closeout recovery estimate
source_scope: official CMS, HHS, OMB, and PaymentAccuracy sources
capture_rule: Capture canonical URL, observed date, Part D overpayment estimate language, audit recovery language, recoverable or collectible amount basis, and limitations.
success_rule: Success requires official source language that links the FY2024 overpayment estimate to recoverable/collectible amounts or explicitly limits recovery language to specific audits.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
